description: Corpus recall audit: 116 coffee-roaster Reddit posts (title+selftext+comments, flattened recursively) hand-labeled for discourse shape and genuine pain-expression, then cross-checked against stage_3 representative_quotes to find pain passages the pipeline never surfaced (misses) vs. ones it already had (already_surfaced).
